description: This dashboard provides key insights into the performance and health of Storage Operators within the Walrus decentralized storage network. Storage Operators are the backbone of the system, responsible for storing and serving data slivers that collectively form the decentralized storage layer.

panels.description: Displays the current epoch number in the Walrus network, indicating the network's operational state.
panels.title: Current Epoch

panels.description: Number of shards owned by this storage node.
panels.title: Shards Owned

panels.description: Number of checkpoints the node is behind according to runtime monitoring (used for health). This is the lag observed by the runtime monitor, which may differ slightly from the checkpoint downloader lag because it reflects a different point in the pipeline (e.g. after event processing) and evaluation time.
panels.title: Runtime Lag

panels.description: Total checkpoint parsing errors (indicates incompatibility of checkpoint data).
panels.title: Checkpoint Parsing Errors

panels.description: Shows the current build version of the Walrus Storage Node.
panels.title: Build Version

panels.description: Displays the chain identifier of the Walrus network.
panels.title: Chain ID

panels.description: Displays the total uptime of the Walrus Storage Node in days, indicating its operational status.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: Displays the current status of the Walrus storage node.
panels.title: Status

panels.description: Displays the timeline of Walrus Storage Node epoch states, highlighting transitions between inactive (0) and active (1) statuses.
panels.title: Epoch State Timeline

panels.description: Displays the uptime trend status of the Walrus Storage Node. Green indicates uptime is increasing, and red indicates it is not.
panels.title: Uptime Timeline

panels.description: Displays the current SUI address used by the Walrus Storage Node.
panels.title: Address

panels.description: Shows the historical Sui token balance of the Walrus storage node.
panels.title: Sui Balance Over Time

panels.description: Displays the current SUI token balance (in SUI) for the storage node in the Walrus network.
panels.title: Sui Balance

panels.description: Number of checkpoints the checkpoint downloader is behind the Sui full node: the gap between the latest checkpoint the download pipeline has fetched and the latest available on the full node. This measures how far behind the ingestion pipeline is; it does not include processing delay after download.
panels.title: Checkpoint Lag

panels.description: Displays the number of active workers in the checkpoint downloader's worker pool for the Walrus network.
panels.title: Active Workers

panels.description: Displays the total number of checkpoints downloaded by the event processor in the Walrus network.
panels.title: Total Downloaded Checkpoints

panels.description: Displays the latest full checkpoint downloaded by the event processor in the Walrus network.
panels.title: Latest Downloaded Checkpoint

panels.description: Checkpoint downloader lag over time (same metric as the Checkpoint Lag stat). Shows how many checkpoints the download pipeline is behind the full node. Spikes indicate the node is falling behind on fetching checkpoints (e.g. full node slow, network issues, or local overload).
panels.title: Checkpoint Lag Over Time

panels.description: Shows the timeline of the latest full checkpoint downloaded by the event processor in the Walrus network.
panels.title: Checkpoint Download Over Time

panels.description: Displays a summary of owned and read-only shard statuses.
panels.title: Summary

panels.description: Displays the statuses of owned shards.
panels.title: Shard Status

panels.description: Displays the total unencoded size of all uploaded blobs based on metadata.
panels.title: Total Metadata Blob Size Processed

panels.description: Displays the total number of storage confirmations issued.
panels.title: Total Storage Confirmations

panels.description: Displays the total count of metadata operations (stored and retrieved) in the Walrus network.
panels.title: Total Metadata Operations

panels.description: Displays the total count of sliver operations (retrieved and stored) across all types (primary and secondary).
panels.title: Total Sliver Operations

panels.description: Displays the rate of sliver operations (retrieved and stored) over time, separated by type (primary or secondary).
panels.title: Sliver Operations Rate

panels.description: Displays the rate of metadata operations (stored and retrieved) over time, enabling a comparison of storage and retrieval rates.
panels.title: Rates of Metadata Operations

panels.description: Displays the rate at which storage confirmations are issued over time in the Walrus network.
panels.title: Rate of Storage Confirmations Issued

panels.description: Displays the number of Walrus events currently in the pending state.
panels.title: Pending Events

panels.description: Displays the number of Walrus events currently in the persisted state.
panels.title: Persisted Events

panels.description: Displays the progress of persisted events in the Walrus network over time.
panels.title: Persisted Event Cursor Progress

panels.description: Displays the average processing time for each event type in the Walrus network, with color thresholds for performance monitoring.
panels.title: Average Event Processing Time

panels.description: Displays the latency distribution for spans in the storage node service, categorized by span names.
panels.title: Latency Distribution (95th percentile)

panels.description: Displays the average latency for spans in the storage node service.
panels.title: Average Latency

panels.description: Displays the current number of blob recoveries that are in-progress on the node in the Walrus network.
panels.title: Blob Recovery In-Progress

panels.description: Displays the current number of blob recoveries queued by the node in the Walrus network.
panels.title: Blob Recovery Queued

panels.description: Current number of ongoing blob syncs.
panels.title: Ongoing Blob Syncs

panels.description: Recover blob progress.
panels.title: Recover Blob Progress

panels.description: Sync blob metadata progress.
panels.title: Sync Metadata Progress

panels.description: Displays the timeline of blob recovery backlog states in the Walrus network, highlighting transitions between 'in-progress' and 'queued' statuses.
panels.title: Blob Recovery Backlog Timeline

panels.description: Displays the time (in seconds) spent recovering blobs in the Walrus network, categorized by skip and success statuses.
panels.title: Blob Recovery Duration

panels.description: Displays the time spent recovering blob parts (metadata, primary, secondary) in the Walrus network, categorized by status (success, skip).
panels.title: Blob Part Recovery Duration

panels.description: Last epoch for which garbage collection was completed.
panels.title: GC Last Completed Epoch

panels.description: Total expired blob objects deleted.
panels.title: GC Expired Blobs Deleted

panels.description: Total blob data deletion attempts by status.
panels.title: GC Blob Data Deletion Attempts

panels.description: Average Sui RPC call latency.
panels.title: Sui RPC Call Duration

panels.description: Cumulative retries for Sui RPC calls. get_full_checkpoint: retries when fetching full checkpoint data from the primary full node; high values indicate primary or network instability. get_full_checkpoint_with_failover: retries on the backup full node after failover; high values indicate both primary and failover are under stress.
panels.title: Sui RPC Retries

panels.description: Pending metadata cache entries.
panels.title: Pending Metadata Cache

panels.description: Pending sliver cache: blobs, bytes, slivers.
panels.title: Pending Sliver Cache

panels.description: Total RocksDB background errors across column families. Alert if > 0.
panels.title: RocksDB Background Errors

panels.description: Number of column families with compaction pending (0/1 per CF).
panels.title: RocksDB Compaction Pending

panels.description: Block cache usage vs capacity.
panels.title: RocksDB Block Cache Usage

panels.description: Shows the block cache hit rate for each column family in the Walrus Storage Node over time, helping identify trends and patterns in cache usage.
panels.title: Block Cache Hit Rate Over Time

panels.description: Shows the block read count for each column family in the Walrus Storage Node over time. This metric highlights instances of direct file system reads, indicating potential cache misses or scenarios where the block cache is disabled.
panels.title: Block Read Count Over Time

panels.description: Bytes read from storage per second by column family (MiB/s). Counter; rate derived from block_read_byte. Useful for analyzing read volume and bottlenecks. If the panel is empty, check time range or scrape target.
panels.title: Block Read Rate Over Time

panels.description: Bytes read for values returned by Get operations per second by column family (MiB/s). Counter; rate derived from get_read_bytes. If Grafana shows 'metric might not be a counter', the metric is a counter; the warning can be ignored.
panels.title: Get Read Bytes Over Time

panels.description: Displays the duration of HTTP requests for different routes and their status codes in the Walrus Storage Node over time. The right column in the legend shows the HTTP method, route (Name), and status code (Status).
panels.title: HTTP Request Duration Over Time

title: Walrus Storage Node
